[u][b][color=#f1c232][size=5]A true to life brewing system![/size][/color][/b][/u]
[size=2]Are you tired of putting raw grain in a keg and getting beer? Do you think, "yikes that's not how REAL brewing works..." and want a more exciting and customizable brewing experience? Then this mod is for you![/size]

[size=2]Take grain and malt it, then mash it, then filter it, kettle it, add the hops, and even age it into liquor![/size]

[size=2]Adds in the brewing system from [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12345]Durin's Rest[/url][size=2] as a stand-alone mod for those who don't want the new town added in [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12345]Durin's Rest[/url][size=2]﻿ but still want to experience a true to life brewing system in Stardew Valley![/size]


[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Light Malter:[/color][/u]
[size=2]A combination of multiple devices that together turn raw starchy produce into ground and roasted grain. This version cooks the grain only a little.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Medium Malter:[/color][/u]
[size=2]A combination of multiple devices that together turn raw starchy produce into ground and roasted grain. This version cooks the grain a medium amount.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Dark Malter:[/color][/u]
[size=2]A combination of multiple devices that together turn raw starchy produce into ground and roasted grain. This version cooks the grain until it is dark.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Mash Tun:[/color][/u]
[size=2]A vessel used in the mashing process to convert starches in the grain into sugars for fermentation.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Lauter Tun:[/color][/u]
[size=2]A vessel for separating the wort from the solids of the mash.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Kettle:[/color][/u]
[size=2]A vessel in which beer wort is boiled typically alongside hops to achieve sterilization, wort concentration, and hop extraction.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Fermenter:[/color][/u]
[size=2]A hearty vessel where wort is held as it is fermented into beer. This is where the magic happens![/size]

[u][color=#f1c232]Dwarven Still:[/color][/u]
[size=2]An apparatus for distilling alcohols. Comprised of a vaporization chamber and a cooling column in which the vapor is condensed into spirits.[/size]

[color=#f1c232][size=5][b][u]Suggested Accompanying Mods:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]
Automate[/url] - Place a chest next to a machine (like a furnace or crystalarium), and the machine will automatically pull raw items from the chest and push processed items into it. Connect multiple machines with a chest to link them.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate[/url] - This mod integrates Producer Framework Mod with the Automate mod.




[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img][size=2][color=#f1c232][b]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Windows Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]here on the wiki[/url]﻿ if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on Windows)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains 4 folders, one of which is "[JA] Dwarven Brewing") into your "SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods \ Durin's Rest \ [JA] Dwarven Brewing"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]

[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]
[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]MacOS Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1) [/b][/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Mac]here on the wiki﻿[/url] if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on MacOS)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains 4 folders, one of which is "[JA] Dwarven Brewing") into your "Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods \ Durin's Rest \ [JA] Dwarven Brewing"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]

Compatible with Multi-Player.
